goal: One shared NOX model/director + three distinct OS subagent processes with independent PID and context; arbitrary count of typed tasks accepted in one request (30 is only the current backlog).
security: Three real separately spawned CPU/IPC subagent processes call only EXISTING single local NOX model; no duplicated model/GPU trainer/S03/backend. All model replies remain CANDIDATE_NOT_APPLIED pending authorized existing dispatcher validation. STOP and fresh owner writer lease checked on each dispatch. Do not clear STOP or delete protected assets.
next_steps: Integrate owner_subagent_processes into existing ONEHOST dispatcher under source SHA + owner ACL; do not create another daemon or scheduler
Owner-native verify three unique child PIDs, six native worker status, local model IPC and cgroup headroom
Only then map 30 existing backlog entries to reviewed typed tasks and submit in one batch; future batches may contain any resource-admitted number
Persist signed native job IDs, status and S03 receipt for actual changes; candidates are never automatic PASS
